summary: All 7 plan phases completed. Added an additive --findings mode to verify-deploy.sh (FINDING-prefixed, gate-labeled, sorted, deduplicated output; default-mode output/exit codes verified byte-identical to the pre-edit script). Rewrote the authoritative Failure contract in batch-orchestration-guardrails.md into three branches plus a Baseline mechanism, Exit-2 resolution, and one Rejected alternative. Rewrote skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md's Stage MT-3 step 7 to capture a pre-redeploy baseline, run deploy-headless.sh, capture the post-redeploy baseline, and branch three ways (deploy-headless failure / newly-introduced verify-deploy finding / pre-existing-only verify-deploy finding), and carried verify_deploy_baseline_notices through Stage MT-5's field-read list, exit-status-resolution note, reporting instruction, and jq emission. Took the CONDITIONAL PATH on Phase 6 (file_scope already extended by the operator to include skill-orchestrate-hard/SKILL.md) and mirrored the three-branch summary into that file's Transcribed block, preserving the CO-MAINTENANCE note verbatim. Rendered the third operator-visible state in commands/orchestrate.md's Consolidated Output template as a new Pre-Existing Deploy-Verify Failures section, and enriched the Deferred (redeploy checkpoint) Reason-cell text. Phase 7's verification-bar sweep demonstrated all six criteria with live evidence against this repo's actual standing verify-deploy.sh failure (criterion 1) and a scratch-copy induced failure (criterion 2), and caught and fixed a real correctness bug in the pre/post exit-code capture pattern along the way.

artifacts.summary: Implementation summary covering all 7 phases and the six-criterion verification bar, with captured evidence for the pre-existing-failure and newly-introduced-failure scenarios.

decisions_made: fail() in verify-deploy.sh gained an optional 3rd argument that overrides (or, if empty, suppresses) the default $1 finding text, rather than the plan's literal unconditional append -- needed for the count-free STRICT_CORE_DEPLOY finding (Decision 4) and to avoid the two gate-level aggregate fail() calls emitting a redundant generic finding alongside the per-underlying-finding lines extracted separately.

Phase 6 CONDITIONAL PATH taken: specs/state.json's file_scope for this task was confirmed to already contain agent-system/extensions/core/skills/skill-orchestrate-hard/SKILL.md as its fifth entry (extended by the operator before dispatch, per the delegation message), so the mirror edit was performed rather than the default record-only path. file_scope itself was not edited by this implementer.

Fixed a real correctness bug discovered during Phase 7's own criterion-1 evidence run: the documented pre/post capture pattern X=$(cmd | grep ... | sort -u); EXIT=$? reads the pipeline's LAST command's exit status, not cmd's own, because a pipeline inside a command substitution runs in its own subshell whose PIPESTATUS does not propagate to the parent shell. Fixed in both skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md and its skill-orchestrate-hard/SKILL.md mirror by capturing the exit code first, as the sole command in its substitution, then filtering the already-captured text as a separate step. Verified empirically both that the bug existed and that the fix resolves it.
scope_notes: Phase 6's default path (recording a blocker for a future task, per the plan's Scope Note 1) did not apply -- the conditional mirror-edit path was taken because file_scope was already extended. No outstanding blocker recorded for the hard-mode file.

check-extension-docs.sh --quiet reports 4 pre-existing FAIL: lines (deployed script content drift / not-in-provides.scripts), one of which (scripts/verify-deploy.sh) is the expected, documented consequence of editing a source-store script without a subsequent redeploy per source-store-deploy-boundary.md -- a live instance of the exact pre-existing-failure scenario this task's mechanism is designed to handle, not a defect in this task's deliverables.
